notes.uniquePublications: Deduplicated across hubs by DOI, PMID and normalized title.
notes.hubPlacements: A publication may be indexed in more than one evidence hub.
notes.institutions: Indexed author affiliations, not endorsements or confirmed study locations.
notes.animalLabelledRecords: Veterinary catalogue records carrying at least one non-human, non-in-vitro animal label.
notes.animalEvidenceLabels: Includes named animal/model labels plus Other animal; it is not a count of approved species.
